findings.commitment: Deploy Coral Pay's production environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will deploy Coral Pay's production environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.
Provider will deploy Customer's production environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

findings.reason: Elva committed to hosting Coral Pay on Microsoft Azure, but the catalogue only lists AWS and GCP as supported clouds for regional deployment in Australia; Azure is not an offerable option and cannot be fixed with an exception.

findings.commitment: Screen every NUSD recipient wallet on Solana for Coral Pay's Australian contractor payout launch

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will screen the recipient wallet of every NUSD payout on Solana through its pre-built analytics integration before release.
Provider will provide NUSD recipient-wallet screening for Customer's Solana payouts through Elva's pre-built analytics integration, in accordance with the Wallet Screening Specification in Annex A.

findings.reason: Elva promised Solana wallet screening for an Australian launch, but the on-chain wallet screening catalogue only covers the SG region with Ethereum and Polygon networks; there is no Australia region and no Solana network at all, so this cannot be sold or approved as an exception.

findings.commitment: Deliver two 90-minute operations training sessions for Coral Pay's payout operations team before launch

promise_quotes.quote: Elva will deliver two 90-minute operations training sessions for Coral Pay's payout operations team before launch.

findings.reason: The proposal firmly commits Elva to two training sessions before go-live, but neither the draft SOW nor the draft contract (including Annex A) mention any training obligation, so this commitment is unenforceable as currently papered.
